## What happens The "Merge release metadata through protected PR" step of the fleet release workflow (canonical `.github/workflows/release.yml` here, copied into about 37 packages) blames workflow approval for every release PR that times out after any of its runs was once `action_required`. On 2026-11-11 five Daily Release runs ended with: ``` Release PR #N did not merge within 30 minutes because its CI run is awaiting workflow approval (last state: BLOCKED). Approve the run linked above once; ... ``` What was actually wrong, with no run awaiting approval at that point: | Release PR | Real state | | --- | --- | | unbraind/pm-web#316 | CI ran and failed (`test (22)`, `test (26)`) | | unbraind/pm-graph#207 | CI ran and failed (`test (22)`, `test (26)`, coverage gate) | | unbraind/pm-ado#104 | checks green, branch BEHIND main | | unbraind/pm-vcs#196 | checks green, branch BEHIND main | | unbraind/pm-rl#164 | merge conflicts (DIRTY) | ## Cause `awaiting_approval=1` is set the first time the loop sees an `action_required` run on the release commit, and it is never cleared. Once that run is approved (by the step's own `approve` call or by a maintainer) and then fails, or the branch falls behind, the deadline message still takes the approval branch. The accurate message (`failing: …`, `still settling: …`) is never printed. The wrong diagnosis cost a night of triage ("waiting for a runner", then "awaiting approval"). ## Expected - **Recompute at the deadline.** Report approval only for runs that are still `action_required` or `waiting` at that moment. - **Name the real state otherwise:** failing check names with their run links, `BEHIND` (strict up-to-date: update the branch), `DIRTY` (regenerate the release metadata) or still settling. - **Tests that fail on revert:** - approved-then-failed reports the failing checks; - still-waiting reports approval; - BEHIND and DIRTY each report their state and remedy. Propagation to the packages should go through the existing template path, not through hand copies. --- ### GitHub comments (1) > **@coderabbitai[bot]** (2026-11-12T12:00:46Z) > > > > >
